note: City of Cottonwood Shores, TX. INSTRUMENT: Zoning Ordinance (Ord. 14000, Exhibit 9B) §§ 2.01(j) Chart 1 (yards/height), 2.01(k) Chart 2 (lot coverage/accessory standards) and Chart 3 (F.A.R.); current through Ord. No. 12001 (2026-04-19). SOURCE: ecode360.com, pack C (2026-10-07), cross-matched against the register (LDT #800). SCOPE: all 18 of Cottonwood Shores' districts serve -- pack C found no conditional or no-dimensional-standards district in this city's chart. READING RULES: (1) Chart 1's R-1/R-2/R-3/M-1/M-2 rows state lot coverage and impervious cover as a SCHEDULE keyed to lot size (per Chart 2: <=5,000 sf = 50%/60%; 5,001-10,000 = 40%/45%; 10,001-43,560 = 40%/45%; >43,560 = 35%/30%), not one scalar per district -- coding any single tier's number as THE district value would be wrong for parcels in the other tiers (WDLL check 8, zero wrong values), so max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct are not_specified for these five districts and the full tiered schedule is quoted in each one's provenance. (2) C-1/C-2/C-3/GUI/I-1/I-2 and the PUD family (PUD, PUD-R, PUD-M, PUD-C, CUD) instead state a flat building-coverage percentage AND a flat, separately-stated impervious-cover percentage (e.g. "60% buildings / 70% impervious") -- both are coded, into max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct respectively. (3) OS and A are not listed in Chart 2 at all, so both coverage fields are not_specified for those two (never read as a permissive zero). (4) The PUD family's height cell is "****", a footnote marker used TWICE in the ordinance's own footnote key for two different zones ("within 100 ft North of Cottonwood Drive: not to exceed 25 ft" vs. "within 200 ft South of Cottonwood Drive: defined within the development agreement") -- since the district-wide height depends on which zone a parcel sits in, and the southern zone has no number at all, max_height_ft is not_specified (999) for all five PUD-family rows rather than picking the one zone's 25-ft cap. (5) R-1's front yard ("25 feet*") and M-1's front/rear ("18 feet*" / "4 feet*") carry a footnote (* = "for 100-foot-deep lots") that qualifies the stated figure rather than offering an alternative number; the stated figure is coded and the qualifier is quoted. SENTINELS: not_specified = 100, except max_height_ft's canonical 999. No code-section atom corpus exists yet for cottonwood_shores_tx; every value is primary-source-verified.
